The '''Ardougne Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in and near [[Ardougne]], such as [[Yanille]] and [[Port Khazard]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Two-pints]] in the [[Flying Horse Inn]], in [[East Ardougne]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

*Earn twice as many [[death rune]]s from trading in [[Cat|cats]] to [[Civilian|civilians]] in [[West Ardougne]]
*Drops from [[Jubster]]s and [[Frogeel]]s will be [[noted]] in the [[Creature Creation]] activity

===Rewards===
*[[Ardougne cloak 2]]:
**Three daily teleports to the [[farming patch]] at the [[Ardougne farm]]
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 40
*Drops from [[Unicow]]s, [[Newtroost]]s, and [[Spidine]]s will be [[noted]] in the [[Creature Creation]] activity
*[[Wizard Cromperty]] offers you 100 [[noted]] [[pure essence]] for free every day
*Ability to change the [[ring of life]] teleport location to [[Ardougne]]
*Chance on receiving additional [[runes]] at the [[Ourania Altar]] (chance [[Ourania_Altar#Ardougne_diary|varies]] per rune)
*10% increased chance of successfully [[Thieving#Pickpocketing|pickpocketing]] within [[Ardougne]]
*Hold up to 56 [[coin pouch]]es at a time, up from 28

*[[Ardougne cloak 3]]:
**Five daily teleports to the [[farming patch]] at the [[Ardougne farm]]
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 50

*10% increased chance of successfully [[Thieving#Pickpocketing|pickpocketing]] anywhere around [[Gielinor]]
*Hold up to 84 [[coin pouch]]es at a time, up from 56

==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Ardougne" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Catch a [[Manta ray]] in the [[Fishing Trawler]] and cook it in [[Port Khazard]].
''Note: Completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.''
|

|-

|

*{{SCP|Thieving|80|link=y}}

''Note: You must use the [[spinning wheel]] in [[Witchaven]] to make the [[crossbow string]] and the [[anvil]] in [[Yanille]] to make the [[runite limbs]]. Fletching the [[yew stock]] and completing the [[rune crossbow]] can be done in either settlement. Completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Crafting|10|link=y}}, {{SCP|Smithing|91|link=y}} and {{SCP|Fletching|69|link=y}}
*[[Yew logs]], [[runite bar]], [[hammer]], [[knife]], and [[sinew]] or a [[tree root]]

|5. Imbue a [[Salve amulet]] at [[Nightmare Zone]], or equip a Salve amulet that was [[Salve amulet(i)|imbued]] there.
''Note: You cannot use a [[scroll of imbuing]] from [[Emir's Arena]] or use [[Zeal Tokens]] from [[Soul Wars]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1356917400210448389|date=3 February 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100999|archivedate=5 February 2021|quote=Yes. Seems to be the case for everything that can be imbued in the two different places - rings, amulets, etc. I suspect that was to stop people getting the imbue in one place, then trying to refund it in the other place.}}

''In [[Deadman Mode]] only: the task becomes "Attempt to equip an imbued Salve amulet at the [[Nightmare Zone]] plinth." This must be a [[salve amulet (ei)]], the regular imbued version will not work.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of the [[Haunted Mine]] 
*Access to the [[Nightmare Zone]]
*[[Salve amulet(i)]] or [[Salve amulet(ei)]], or 800,000 [[Nightmare_Zone#Upgrades|Nightmare Zone points]] points to imbue the [[Salve amulet|normal one]] (reduced to 400,000 points with the [[Combat_Achievements/Hard|hard tier]] of the {{SCP|combatachievement}} [[Combat Achievements]] completed)

''Note: You have to successfully hit the player, so multiple casts are recommended. In Deadman Mode, the task is "Visit the Castle Wars lobby with at least 94 Magic after completing Desert Treasure I."
